blocks.zh: 附錄9：經濟效益與永續設計
blocks.en: Appendix 9: Economics and Sustainable Design

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 HVAC 系統的 Total Cost of Ownership (總擁有成本) 概念，掌握資本支出與營運成本的平衡決策
blocks.en: Understand the Total Cost of Ownership concept for HVAC systems, and how to balance capital expenditure against operating cost

blocks.zh: 掌握 HVAC 系統故障對藥品生產的財務衝擊，以及冗餘設計的成本效益分析
blocks.en: Understand the financial impact of HVAC failure on drug manufacturing, and the cost-benefit analysis of redundant design

blocks.zh: 學習 Life Cycle Cost (生命週期成本) 的各項因素：能源、耗材、維護、可靠度
blocks.en: Learn the factors that make up Life Cycle Cost: energy, consumables, maintenance and reliability

blocks.zh: 認識各種 Energy Recovery (能源回收) 技術及其在製藥設施中的應用限制
blocks.en: Become familiar with the various Energy Recovery technologies and their limitations in pharmaceutical facilities

blocks.zh: 了解 Sustainable Design (永續設計) 的評級系統（LEED、Green Globes）及其對製藥 HVAC 的特殊考量
blocks.en: Understand the rating systems for Sustainable Design (LEED, Green Globes) and the special considerations for pharmaceutical HVAC

blocks.zh: 學習綠建築設計流程中 HVAC 工程師的關鍵角色與貢獻
blocks.en: Learn the key role and contribution of the HVAC engineer in the green building design process

blocks.en: 15.1 HVAC System Economics

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Life Cycle Cost (生命週期成本)：從設計、採購、安裝、運轉、維護到最終除役的全部費用總和。ISPE 在此強調，HVAC 系統的營運成本 (Operating Cost) 通常遠超過初始的資本支出 (Capital Cost)。
blocks.en: Life Cycle Cost: the sum of all costs from design, procurement, installation, operation and maintenance through to final decommissioning. ISPE stresses here that the operating cost of an HVAC system usually far exceeds the initial capital cost.

blocks.zh: Net Present Value, NPV (淨現值)：將未來各年的現金流以折現率折算回現在的價值，是評估長期投資方案的標準財務工具。
blocks.en: Net Present Value, NPV: the value of future annual cash flows discounted back to the present at a discount rate. It is the standard financial tool for evaluating long-term investment options.

blocks.zh: Cost Model (成本模型)：在專案早期建立的財務模型，用於估算設施全生命週期的維護、耗材和能源費用。這個模型應該在設計階段就建立，而非事後補做。
blocks.en: Cost Model: a financial model built early in the project to estimate the maintenance, consumables and energy costs over the facility life cycle. This model should be built during the design phase, not added retrospectively.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: HVAC 系統的 Life Cycle Cost 就像買車的全生命週期成本 (TCO)：一台便宜的車買來 50 萬，但如果油耗高、維修頻繁、零件昂貴，10 年下來可能花掉 150 萬；反而一台較貴的油電混合車買價 80 萬，10 年總花費可能只要 120 萬。HVAC 也是一樣——Capital Cost 只是冰山一角，Operating Cost 才是真正的大頭。
blocks.en: The Life Cycle Cost of an HVAC system is like the total cost of owning a car (TCO): a cheap car may cost 500,000 to buy, but if it uses a lot of fuel, needs frequent repairs and has expensive parts, it can cost 1.5 million over 10 years; a more expensive hybrid at 800,000 may cost only 1.2 million in total over the same 10 years. HVAC is the same: Capital Cost is only the tip of the iceberg, and Operating Cost is the real bulk.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別提到「這些概念對工程師來說往往是陌生的」——這是一個非常重要的提醒。在 CDMO 環境中，工程團隊習慣追求「最穩健的設計」，但未必考慮成本效益。好的 HVAC 設計必須在品質保證與經濟效益之間取得平衡。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically notes that "these concepts are often unfamiliar to engineers", which is a very important reminder. In a CDMO environment, engineering teams are used to pursuing the "most robust design" without necessarily considering cost-effectiveness. A good HVAC design must strike a balance between quality assurance and economic benefit.

blocks.zh: 成本模型應該是「全面的」(holistic)，要考慮 HVAC 對生產成本、停機時間、產品損失和生產力損失的影響——不只是電費和維護費。
blocks.en: The cost model should be "holistic": it must consider the impact of HVAC on production cost, downtime, product loss and loss of productivity, not just electricity and maintenance costs.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的設施在專案設計階段是否建立過 HVAC 成本模型？如果沒有，你認為這會導致什麼問題？
blocks.en: Did your facility build an HVAC cost model during the project design phase? If not, what problems do you think this causes?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 建議用 NPV 而非單純比較「哪個方案比較便宜」？在 10-15 年的設施壽命中，能源價格波動如何影響決策？
blocks.en: Why does ISPE recommend using NPV rather than simply comparing which option is cheaper? Over a facility life of 10-15 years, how do energy price fluctuations affect the decision?

blocks.zh: 15.1.1 Risk to Product and Associated Costs 15.1.1 產品風險與相關成本
blocks.en: 15.1.1 Risk to Product and Associated Costs

blocks.zh: Impact of Failure (故障影響)：HVAC 故障在製藥業的後果不只是「不舒服」，而是可能導致整批產品報廢或長期穩定性試驗數據失效。這種損失可能高達數百萬甚至數千萬美元。
blocks.en: Impact of Failure: the consequence of an HVAC failure in the pharmaceutical industry is not just "discomfort"; it can lead to the scrapping of an entire batch or the invalidation of long-term stability study data. Such losses can reach millions or even tens of millions of US dollars.

blocks.zh: Redundancy (冗餘設計)：為關鍵系統配置備份。但冗餘不是免費的午餐——雙套 AHU 意味著也需要雙套冷水機和循環泵，連帶增加設計、啟動和維護的複雜度。
blocks.en: Redundancy: providing backup for critical systems. But redundancy is not a free lunch: dual AHUs also mean dual chillers and circulation pumps, which adds to the complexity of design, start-up and maintenance.

blocks.zh: Over-specification (過度規格)：指定過窄的溫濕度容差，不但不會讓產品更好，反而會導致更大、更複雜、更昂貴的系統，而且更難維護。
blocks.en: Over-specification: specifying overly narrow temperature and humidity tolerances does not make the product better. Instead it leads to a larger, more complex and more expensive system that is harder to maintain.

blocks.zh: 「過度規格」就像要求你家冷氣維持恆溫 22.0 ± 0.1°C——為了達到這個精度，你需要安裝工業級的感測器和控制器，電費暴增，但你穿短袖或長袖根本感覺不到差異。在製藥中，如果產品在 20-25°C 範圍內都是合格的，為什麼要花大錢把溫度控制在 22 ± 0.5°C？
blocks.en: "Over-specification" is like demanding that your home air conditioner hold a constant 22.0 ± 0.1°C. To reach that precision you would need industrial-grade sensors and controllers, and your electricity bill would soar, yet you could not feel any difference whether you wore short or long sleeves. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, if the product is acceptable anywhere in the 20-25°C range, why spend a lot of money to control the temperature at 22 ± 0.5°C?

blocks.zh: 故障模式分析是成本決策的基礎：ISPE 列出的四種故障模式（氣流、濾網、溫度、濕度）都需要進行風險評估。在 CDMO 中，無菌充填區的 AHU 故障可能導致整個批次報廢，每批生物製劑的價值可能超過 500 萬美元——這就是為什麼無菌區通常會配置冗餘系統。
blocks.en: Failure mode analysis is the basis of cost decisions: the four failure modes listed by ISPE (airflow, filters, temperature, humidity) all require risk assessment. In a CDMO, an AHU failure in an aseptic filling area can lead to the loss of an entire batch, and each batch of biologic may be worth more than USD 5 million. This is why aseptic areas are usually provided with redundant systems.

blocks.zh: User Requirements 不應該是「越嚴越好」：這是工程師常見的心態陷阱。ISPE 明確指出，更窄的容差不等於更好的系統，反而可能帶來無謂的成本增加。
blocks.en: User Requirements should not be "the tighter the better": this is a common mindset trap for engineers. ISPE states clearly that a narrower tolerance does not mean a better system and may instead bring unnecessary extra cost.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
冗餘設計投資決策：

故障年度預期損失 = P(failure) × Impact($)

若 P(failure) = 2%/year, Impact = $5M/batch × 10 batches/year
年度預期損失 = 0.02 × $50M = $1M/year

冗餘系統額外成本 = $500K capital + $50K/year maintenance
Payback Period (投資回收期) = $500K / ($1M - $50K) = 0.53 year

結論：半年就能回收——明確應該投資冗餘系統！
blocks.en:
Redundancy investment decision:

Annual expected loss from failure = P(failure) × Impact($)

If P(failure) = 2%/year, Impact = $5M/batch × 10 batches/year
Annual expected loss = 0.02 × $50M = $1M/year

Additional cost of redundant system = $500K capital + $50K/year maintenance
Payback Period = $500K / ($1M - $50K) = 0.53 year

Conclusion: payback in half a year, so the redundant system is clearly worth the investment!

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，客戶往往會在 User Requirement Specification (URS) 中指定非常嚴格的溫濕度範圍。作為設施擁有者，你需要有能力向客戶解釋：「我們的系統能力範圍是 X，您的產品規格容許範圍是 Y，我們建議以 Z 作為操作範圍」——這種對話需要同時具備技術知識和商業溝通能力。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, clients often specify very tight temperature and humidity ranges in the User Requirement Specification (URS). As the facility owner, you need to be able to explain to the client: "Our system capability range is X, your product specification allows range Y, and we recommend Z as the operating range." This kind of conversation requires both technical knowledge and commercial communication skills.

blocks.zh: 你的設施中，哪些 HVAC 系統配置了冗餘？你認為這些冗餘投資是否合理？
blocks.en: Which HVAC systems in your facility have redundancy? Do you think these redundancy investments are justified?

blocks.zh: 如果 HVAC 系統在批次充填過程中突然故障，你的 SOP 是什麼？從財務角度看，這個 SOP 帶來多少保護？
blocks.en: If the HVAC system suddenly fails during batch filling, what is your SOP? From a financial perspective, how much protection does this SOP provide?

blocks.zh: 你是否見過「過度規格」的案例？那次經驗的總成本影響是什麼？
blocks.en: Have you seen a case of "over-specification"? What was the total cost impact of that experience?

blocks.zh: 15.1.2 Life Cycle Cost Considerations 15.1.2 生命週期成本考量
blocks.en: 15.1.2 Life Cycle Cost Considerations

blocks.zh: First Cost vs. Life Cycle Cost (首次成本 vs. 生命週期成本)：每個組織的最佳平衡點不同。現金流緊張的公司可能寧願選擇低資本支出但較高營運成本的方案，而資金充裕的大型藥企可能傾向一次投資到位以換取長期節省。
blocks.en: First Cost vs. Life Cycle Cost: the best balance point differs for every organization. A company with tight cash flow may prefer an option with low capital expenditure but higher operating cost, while a large, well-funded pharmaceutical company may prefer to invest fully up front in exchange for long-term savings.

blocks.zh: Energy Recovery (能源回收)：將排氣中的能量回收再利用。ISPE 介紹了四種主要技術：
blocks.en: Energy Recovery: recovering energy from the exhaust air and reusing it. ISPE describes four main technologies:

blocks.zh: Enthalpy Wheel (全熱交換輪)：回收顯熱+潛熱，但在製藥中很少使用（交叉污染風險）
blocks.en: Enthalpy Wheel: recovers sensible and latent heat, but is rarely used in pharmaceutical facilities (cross-contamination risk)

blocks.zh: Air-to-Air Plate Exchanger (氣對氣板式交換器)：僅回收顯熱，供排氣需相鄰
blocks.en: Air-to-Air Plate Exchanger: recovers sensible heat only, and the supply and exhaust air streams must be adjacent

blocks.zh: Run Around Coil (循環盤管)：供排氣可分離，用乙二醇溶液傳熱
blocks.en: Run Around Coil: the supply and exhaust streams can be separated, with a glycol solution transferring the heat

blocks.zh: Refrigerant Coil (冷媒盤管)：被動冷媒循環，無壓縮機，效率高
blocks.en: Refrigerant Coil: a passive refrigerant loop with no compressor and high efficiency

blocks.zh: Economizer (節能器)：利用較涼爽的室外空氣減少機械冷卻負荷。但在需要壓差控制的製藥潔淨區，不建議使用 economizer，因為風量變化會影響房間壓差。
blocks.en: Economizer: uses cooler outdoor air to reduce the mechanical cooling load. However, an economizer is not recommended for pharmaceutical cleanrooms that require pressure differential control, because changes in airflow affect room pressure differentials.

blocks.zh: 能源回收就像廢熱水器——你洗完熱水澡的廢水還有 35°C，如果能用它來預熱進來的冷水（15°C），你的熱水器就不需要從 15°C 加熱到 42°C，只需從 25°C 加熱到 42°C，能省下大約 60% 的能源。
blocks.en: Energy recovery is like a waste hot water heat exchanger: the waste water from your hot shower is still at 35°C, and if you use it to preheat the incoming cold water (15°C), your water heater no longer has to heat from 15°C to 42°C, only from 25°C to 42°C, saving about 60% of the energy.

blocks.zh: 而 Economizer 則像開窗通風——秋天涼爽的日子不開冷氣，直接打開窗戶就夠涼了。但在需要「無菌手術室」等級控制的空間，你不會隨便開窗，因為會影響壓差和潔淨度。
blocks.en: An economizer, on the other hand, is like opening a window for ventilation: on a cool autumn day you do not run the air conditioner, and simply opening the window is cool enough. But in a space that needs "sterile operating theater" level control, you would not open a window casually, because it would affect pressure differentials and cleanliness.

blocks.zh: V-Belt 效率損失高達 7%：這是一個非常實用的數字。如果一台 AHU 風機的馬達功率是 30kW，7% 的損失就是 2.1kW。一年 8,760 小時運轉，就是 18,396 kWh，以每度電 4 元計算就是約 7.4 萬元/年。改用直驅風機或同步皮帶就能省下大部分。
blocks.en: V-belt efficiency loss of up to 7%: this is a very practical number. If the motor of an AHU fan is 30 kW, a 7% loss is 2.1 kW. Over 8,760 operating hours a year, that is 18,396 kWh, which at 4 per kWh comes to about 74,000 per year. Switching to a direct-drive fan or a synchronous belt saves most of this.

blocks.zh: Makeup Air Pretreatment 策略：在台灣這種高溫高濕氣候中特別重要。先用一台較小的 AHU 處理外氣的濕度，再與回風混合，可以大幅降低主 AHU 的冷卻和再加熱能耗。這是無菌設施和高排氣量 OSD 設施中的常見做法。
blocks.en: Makeup Air Pretreatment strategy: particularly important in a hot, humid climate such as Taiwan. Using a smaller AHU to treat the humidity of the outside air first, and then mixing it with return air, can greatly reduce the cooling and reheating energy of the main AHU. This is common practice in aseptic facilities and in OSD facilities with high exhaust volumes.

blocks.zh: Enthalpy Wheel 在製藥業很少用：雖然能回收顯熱和潛熱，但交叉污染率即使只有 0.04% 也可能在製藥環境中不被接受，尤其是在處理高活性藥物時。
blocks.en: Enthalpy Wheels are rarely used in the pharmaceutical industry: although they can recover both sensible and latent heat, even a cross-contamination rate of only 0.04% may be unacceptable in a pharmaceutical environment, especially when handling highly potent drugs.

blocks.zh:
皮帶驅動節能計算範例：

V-belt 效率 = 93%（損失 7%）
同步皮帶效率 = 98%（損失 2%）
直驅風機效率 = ~100%

30kW 風機年度能耗比較（24/7 運轉）：
  V-belt:    30kW / 0.93 = 32.26kW → 282,598 kWh/yr
  同步皮帶:  30kW / 0.98 = 30.61kW → 268,150 kWh/yr
  直驅:      30kW / 1.00 = 30.00kW → 262,800 kWh/yr

年度節省（V-belt → 直驅）：
  19,798 kWh × $0.12/kWh = $2,376/yr
  10 台 AHU = $23,760/yr 節省
blocks.en:
Belt drive energy saving calculation example:

V-belt efficiency = 93% (7% loss)
Synchronous belt efficiency = 98% (2% loss)
Direct-drive fan efficiency = ~100%

Annual energy consumption comparison for a 30 kW fan (24/7 operation):
  V-belt:    30kW / 0.93 = 32.26kW → 282,598 kWh/yr
  Synchronous belt:  30kW / 0.98 = 30.61kW → 268,150 kWh/yr
  Direct drive:      30kW / 1.00 = 30.00kW → 262,800 kWh/yr

Annual saving (V-belt → direct drive):
  19,798 kWh × $0.12/kWh = $2,376/yr
  10 AHUs = $23,760/yr saving

blocks.zh: 對於台灣的 CDMO 設施，由於全年高溫高濕，以下策略的投資回報最高：
blocks.en: For CDMO facilities in Taiwan, because of the hot and humid conditions all year round, the following strategies give the highest return on investment:

blocks.zh: 外氣預處理 (Makeup Air Pretreatment)：台灣夏季外氣露點常超過 25°C，預處理可以大幅降低主 AHU 的除濕負荷
blocks.en: Makeup Air Pretreatment: in Taiwan the summer outdoor air dew point often exceeds 25°C, and pretreatment can greatly reduce the dehumidification load of the main AHU

blocks.zh: Run Around Coil：適合高排氣量的 CDMO 設施（如粉劑充填、活性藥物處理），因為供排氣可以不相鄰
blocks.en: Run Around Coil: suitable for CDMO facilities with high exhaust volumes (such as powder filling and potent drug handling), because the supply and exhaust streams do not need to be adjacent

blocks.zh: 高效馬達 + 直驅風機：初始投資增加約 15-20%，但通常 2-3 年即可回收
blocks.en: High-efficiency motors + direct-drive fans: initial investment increases by about 15-20%, but payback is usually within 2-3 years

blocks.zh: 你的設施目前使用哪種 Energy Recovery 技術？如果沒有，你認為哪種最適合你的設施條件？
blocks.en: Which Energy Recovery technology does your facility currently use? If none, which do you think is best suited to your facility conditions?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Economizer 不適用於需要壓差控制的潔淨區？如果有人在設計階段提出這個方案，你會如何解釋風險？
blocks.en: Why is an Economizer not suitable for cleanrooms that require pressure differential control? If someone proposed this option at the design stage, how would you explain the risk?

blocks.zh: 對於一個預期壽命 5 年的臨床試驗用設施 vs. 20 年的商業製造設施，你的 HVAC 設備選型策略會有什麼不同？
blocks.en: How would your HVAC equipment selection strategy differ between a clinical trial facility with an expected life of 5 years and a commercial manufacturing facility with a life of 20 years?

blocks.zh: 15.1.2.3-15.1.2.6 Setback, Consumables, Reliability & Other Factors 15.1.2.3-15.1.2.6 回復、耗材、可靠性與其他因素
blocks.en: 15.1.2.3-15.1.2.6 Setback, Consumables, Reliability & Other Factors

blocks.zh: Night Setback (夜間/非運轉時段降載)：在無人生產時降低換氣次數以節省能源。ISPE 建議降至 6 AC/hr（正常操作可能需要 20+ AC/hr），但必須維持壓差關係和臨界條件。恢復到正常條件通常需要 3-4 次空氣稀釋循環。
blocks.en: Night Setback: reducing the air change rate to save energy when there is no production. ISPE suggests reducing to 6 AC/hr (normal operation may need 20+ AC/hr), but the pressure differential relationships and critical conditions must be maintained. Returning to normal conditions usually takes 3-4 air dilution cycles.

blocks.zh: ULPA vs. HEPA：ULPA 濾網（≥99.999% @0.12μm）比一般 HEPA（≥99.97% @0.3μm）更貴，但因為過濾效率更高，在例行測試時不容易出現 "bleed-through" 問題，可以減少 OOS（超規格結果）報告。
blocks.en: ULPA vs. HEPA: ULPA filters (≥99.999% @0.12μm) are more expensive than ordinary HEPA (≥99.97% @0.3μm), but because their filtration efficiency is higher, "bleed-through" problems are less likely to appear during routine testing, which can reduce OOS (out-of-specification result) reports.

blocks.zh: ABMA L10 200,000 hours：這是一個軸承壽命規格。L10 表示在這個運轉時數下，90% 的軸承仍然正常。200,000 小時相當於約 23 年連續運轉——足以覆蓋大多數設施的使用壽命。
blocks.en: ABMA L10 200,000 hours: this is a bearing life specification. L10 means that at this number of operating hours, 90% of the bearings are still in good working order. 200,000 hours is equivalent to about 23 years of continuous operation, enough to cover the service life of most facilities.

blocks.zh: 夜間降載就像辦公大樓的空調排程——下班後不需要維持 22°C 恆溫，可以讓溫度飄升到 28°C。但如果大樓裡有伺服器機房（類比為存放產品的潔淨室），即使下班也不能完全關閉冷氣，只能降低風量但維持溫度範圍。
blocks.en: Night setback is like the air conditioning schedule of an office building: after work there is no need to hold a constant 22°C, and the temperature can drift up to 28°C. But if the building has a server room (analogous to a cleanroom storing product), the cooling cannot be shut off completely even after hours; only the airflow can be reduced while the temperature range is maintained.

blocks.zh: 選擇 ULPA vs. HEPA 濾網就像選購汽車保險——全險（ULPA）比較貴，但出事時（例行測試發現 bleed-through）的處理成本極低；基本險（HEPA）便宜，但一旦需要處理偏差報告，調查成本和停機損失可能遠超過保費差額。
blocks.en: Choosing ULPA vs. HEPA filters is like buying car insurance: comprehensive cover (ULPA) is more expensive, but the cost of handling an incident (bleed-through found in routine testing) is extremely low; basic cover (HEPA) is cheaper, but once a deviation report has to be handled, the investigation cost and downtime loss may far exceed the difference in premium.

blocks.zh: 夜間降載的法規注意事項：無菌充填區依法規要求 20 AC/hr 或 15-20 分鐘恢復時間。降載期間雖然可以降低換氣次數，但必須確保在生產開始前有足夠的恢復時間。建議在 SOP 中明確規定降載條件和恢復程序，並有環境監測數據支撐。
blocks.en: Regulatory considerations for night setback: aseptic filling areas are required to have 20 AC/hr or a recovery time of 15-20 minutes. Although the air change rate can be reduced during setback, you must ensure there is sufficient recovery time before production starts. It is recommended to define the setback conditions and recovery procedure clearly in an SOP, supported by environmental monitoring data.

blocks.zh: HVAC 設備的可靠度直接影響產線稼動率：ISPE 舉了動物房（vivarium）的例子——長期動物研究需要穩定的環境條件，HVAC 故障可能導致多年的數據作廢和產品上市延遲。同樣的邏輯也適用於穩定性試驗室和微生物研究室。
blocks.en: HVAC equipment reliability directly affects line utilization: ISPE gives the example of a vivarium: long-term animal studies need stable environmental conditions, and an HVAC failure can invalidate years of data and delay product launch. The same logic applies to stability testing rooms and microbiology research laboratories.

blocks.zh: 校正策略的經濟學：不是每個壓力錶都需要校正。可以在一組濾網上安裝一個已校正的高壓差開關（作為 GMP 使用），搭配未校正的工程用錶（僅供趨勢參考）。這是一個務實的成本優化策略。
blocks.en: The economics of calibration strategy: not every pressure gauge needs to be calibrated. A calibrated high differential pressure switch (for GMP use) can be installed on a bank of filters, together with uncalibrated engineering gauges (for trending reference only). This is a pragmatic cost optimization strategy.

blocks.zh:
夜間降載節能估算：

假設潔淨室面積 500m², 天花板高度 3m
房間體積 = 1,500 m³

正常模式：20 AC/hr → 30,000 m³/hr 送風量
降載模式：6 AC/hr → 9,000 m³/hr 送風量
風量減少比 = 9,000/30,000 = 30%

風機功率與風量的三次方成正比：
功率比 = (0.30)³ = 0.027 = 2.7%

假設正常風機功率 15kW：
降載功率 = 15 × 0.027 = 0.41kW
每晚節省 = (15 - 0.41)kW × 12hrs = 175 kWh
年度節省 = 175 × 365 = 63,875 kWh
成本節省 = 63,875 × $0.12/kWh ≈ $7,665/yr per room
blocks.en:
Night setback energy saving estimate:

Assume cleanroom area 500m², ceiling height 3m
Room volume = 1,500 m³

Normal mode: 20 AC/hr → 30,000 m³/hr supply airflow
Setback mode: 6 AC/hr → 9,000 m³/hr supply airflow
Airflow reduction ratio = 9,000/30,000 = 30%

Fan power is proportional to the cube of airflow:
Power ratio = (0.30)³ = 0.027 = 2.7%

Assume normal fan power 15kW:
Setback power = 15 × 0.027 = 0.41kW
Saving per night = (15 - 0.41)kW × 12hrs = 175 kWh
Annual saving = 175 × 365 = 63,875 kWh
Cost saving = 63,875 × $0.12/kWh ≈ $7,665/yr per room

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 中，降載策略對多品種共線設施特別有價值：
blocks.en: In a CDMO, a setback strategy is especially valuable for multi-product shared facilities:

blocks.zh: 非充填日：潔淨室降至 6 AC/hr，維持壓差但節省大量風機能耗
blocks.en: Non-filling days: cleanroom reduced to 6 AC/hr, maintaining pressure differentials while saving a large amount of fan energy

blocks.zh: 換線清潔日：可能需要維持較高換氣次數以支持清潔後的粒子恢復
blocks.en: Changeover and cleaning days: a higher air change rate may need to be maintained to support particle recovery after cleaning

blocks.zh: 週末/假日：所有非關鍵區域降載，僅維持壓差和基本溫控
blocks.en: Weekends/holidays: all non-critical areas set back, maintaining only pressure differentials and basic temperature control

blocks.zh: 整合 BMS (Building Management System)：設定排程自動切換，搭配環境監測告警
blocks.en: Integration with BMS (Building Management System): set schedules for automatic switching, together with environmental monitoring alarms

blocks.zh: 一個典型的 CDMO 設施如果有 10 間潔淨室實施夜間降載，年度節省可達 $70,000-$100,000。
blocks.en: A typical CDMO facility that implements night setback in 10 cleanrooms can achieve annual savings of $70,000-$100,000.

blocks.zh: 你的設施是否實施夜間降載？如果是，降載模式的換氣次數是多少？如何確保恢復時間符合法規要求？
blocks.en: Does your facility implement night setback? If so, what is the air change rate in setback mode? How do you ensure the recovery time meets regulatory requirements?

blocks.zh: 你的濾網更換策略是基於時間（固定排程）還是基於壓差（條件觸發）？哪種方式更經濟？
blocks.en: Is your filter replacement strategy time-based (fixed schedule) or pressure-drop-based (condition-triggered)? Which approach is more economical?

blocks.zh: 計算一下：如果你的設施所有 AHU 風機從 V-belt 改為直驅，年度能源節省是多少？
blocks.en: Calculate: if all the AHU fans in your facility were changed from V-belt to direct drive, what would the annual energy saving be?

blocks.zh: 15.2 Sustainable Design for HVAC Systems 15.2 暖通空調系統永續設計
blocks.en: 15.2 Sustainable Design for HVAC Systems

blocks.zh: Sustainable Design (永續設計)：在滿足 GMP 要求的前提下，將環境永續性納入 HVAC 系統設計考量。ISPE 強調這已經從「加分題」變成某些地區的「必答題」。
blocks.en: Sustainable Design: taking environmental sustainability into account in HVAC system design while meeting GMP requirements. ISPE stresses that this has changed from a "bonus question" to a "compulsory question" in some regions.

blocks.zh: Triple Bottom Line — Personnel, Planet, Profit (三重底線 — 人員、地球、利潤)：
blocks.en: Triple Bottom Line: Personnel, Planet, Profit:

blocks.zh: People (人員)：設施對社會和員工的正面影響
blocks.en: People: the positive impact of the facility on society and employees

blocks.zh: Planet (地球)：減少環境干擾、降低碳排放和毒性污染
blocks.en: Planet: reducing environmental disturbance, lowering carbon emissions and toxic pollution

blocks.zh: Profit (利潤)：在永續的同時維持經濟效益和股東回報
blocks.en: Profit: maintaining economic benefit and shareholder return while being sustainable

blocks.zh: 永續設計就像健康飲食——你不會因為追求健康（永續）就放棄美味（功能性和 GMP 合規）或承擔不了的高價（經濟效益）。最好的策略是找到三者的平衡點：營養均衡（對環境好）、好吃（滿足使用需求）、負擔得起（成本合理）。
blocks.en: Sustainable design is like a healthy diet: you would not give up tasty food (functionality and GMP compliance) or take on a price you cannot afford (economic benefit) just because you are pursuing health (sustainability). The best strategy is to find the balance among the three: nutritionally balanced (good for the environment), tasty (meets user needs), affordable (reasonable cost).

blocks.zh: 製藥業的永續挑戰：製藥 HVAC 系統天生就是能源密集型的——高換氣次數、嚴格溫控、大量外氣處理。這使得製藥設施比一般商業建築更難達到綠建築標準。但正因如此，HVAC 的節能改善在製藥設施中的效益也特別顯著。
blocks.en: The sustainability challenge in the pharmaceutical industry: pharmaceutical HVAC systems are inherently energy-intensive, with high air change rates, strict temperature control and large volumes of outside air to treat. This makes pharmaceutical facilities harder than ordinary commercial buildings to bring up to green building standards. But for that very reason, the benefit of HVAC energy-saving improvements is especially significant in pharmaceutical facilities.

blocks.zh: ESG 趨勢對 CDMO 的影響：在 2026 年的今天，越來越多的大型製藥客戶要求 CDMO 合作夥伴提供永續發展報告。擁有 LEED 認證或類似綠建築認證的設施，在 CDMO 競標中可能具有市場差異化優勢。
blocks.en: The impact of ESG trends on CDMOs: today in 2026, more and more large pharmaceutical clients require their CDMO partners to provide sustainability reports. A facility with LEED certification or a similar green building certification may have a market differentiation advantage in CDMO bidding.

blocks.zh: 你的公司是否有永續發展策略或目標？HVAC 系統在其中扮演什麼角色？
blocks.en: Does your company have a sustainability strategy or targets? What role does the HVAC system play in it?

blocks.zh: 「Personnel, Planet, Profit」三重底線中，你認為哪個在製藥 CDMO 中最容易被忽略？為什麼？
blocks.en: Of the "Personnel, Planet, Profit" triple bottom line, which do you think is most easily overlooked in a pharmaceutical CDMO, and why?

blocks.zh: 15.2.3-15.2.4 Rating Systems & Building Energy-Labeling 15.2.3-15.2.4 評級系統與建築能源標示
blocks.en: 15.2.3-15.2.4 Rating Systems & Building Energy-Labeling

blocks.zh: LEED (Leadership in Environmental and Energy Design)：由 USGBC（美國綠建築委員會）開發的全球最知名綠建築評級系統。分為 Certified、Silver、Gold、Platinum 四個等級。HVAC 系統是獲取 LEED 學分的關鍵領域之一。
blocks.en: LEED (Leadership in Environmental and Energy Design): the world's best-known green building rating system, developed by the USGBC (U.S. Green Building Council). It has four levels: Certified, Silver, Gold and Platinum. The HVAC system is one of the key areas for earning LEED credits.

blocks.zh: Green Globes：由 GBI（綠建築倡議組織）管理的另一套評級系統，在美國某些地方政府中被採納為法規。
blocks.en: Green Globes: another rating system, administered by the GBI (Green Building Initiative), which has been adopted as regulation by some local governments in the United States.

blocks.zh: EPBD (Energy Performance of Buildings Directive)：歐盟的建築能效指令，要求所有建築物都需要有能源效能評等（A-G），類似家電的能效標籤。
blocks.en: EPBD (Energy Performance of Buildings Directive): the EU directive on building energy performance, which requires all buildings to have an energy performance rating (A-G), similar to the energy efficiency labels on household appliances.

blocks.zh: 潔淨室例外：ISPE 特別指出，綠建築評級系統可能對潔淨室有例外條款——因為潔淨室的能耗密度（每平方米能耗）遠高於一般空間，直接套用標準並不合理。
blocks.en: Cleanroom exceptions: ISPE specifically points out that green building rating systems may contain exception clauses for cleanrooms, because the energy density of a cleanroom (energy consumption per square meter) is far higher than that of ordinary spaces, so applying the standard directly is not reasonable.

blocks.zh: LEED 認證就像餐廳的米其林星級——你不需要米其林星才能開餐廳（不需要 LEED 才能蓋工廠），但擁有星級認證能讓你在競爭中脫穎而出，吸引更講究的客戶（ESG 導向的大藥廠）。而且就像米其林有不同星級，LEED 也有 Certified → Silver → Gold → Platinum 的分級。
blocks.en: LEED certification is like a Michelin star for a restaurant: you do not need a Michelin star to open a restaurant (you do not need LEED to build a factory), but having a star rating lets you stand out from the competition and attract more discerning customers (ESG-oriented large pharmaceutical companies). And just as Michelin has different star levels, LEED also has the grades Certified → Silver → Gold → Platinum.

blocks.zh: HVAC 工程師不能單獨交付建築評級：ISPE 提醒我們，綠建築認證是一個跨專業的團隊努力，涵蓋建築師、結構、機電、業主和建造商。HVAC 是其中重要的一環，但不是全部。
blocks.en: The HVAC engineer cannot deliver the building rating alone: ISPE reminds us that green building certification is a cross-disciplinary team effort, involving the architect, structural engineers, MEP engineers, the owner and the contractor. HVAC is an important part of it, but not the whole.

blocks.zh: 從「選擇性」到「強制性」的趨勢：永續設計標準正在從自願性指南演變為法規要求。在某些司法管轄區，LEED 或 Green Globes 已被納入建築法規。這意味著未來的製藥設施新建或大規模翻新項目可能必須符合綠建築標準。
blocks.en: The trend from "optional" to "mandatory": sustainable design standards are evolving from voluntary guidelines into regulatory requirements. In some jurisdictions, LEED or Green Globes have already been incorporated into building codes. This means that future new-build or major renovation pharmaceutical facility projects may have to comply with green building standards.

blocks.zh: 你所在地區是否有綠建築法規或獎勵政策？這對你的設施設計決策有何影響？
blocks.en: Does your region have green building regulations or incentive policies? How do they affect your facility design decisions?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 要追求 LEED Gold 認證，潔淨室的高能耗是最大的挑戰。你會提出哪些節能策略來爭取學分？
blocks.en: If your CDMO wants to pursue LEED Gold certification, the high energy consumption of the cleanrooms is the biggest challenge. What energy-saving strategies would you propose to earn credits?

blocks.zh: 15.2.5 New Project Design Process and Considerations 15.2.5 新專案設計流程與考量
blocks.en: 15.2.5 New Project Design Process and Considerations

blocks.zh: Design Charette (設計工作坊)：在專案初期，由所有利害關係人（HVAC 專家、建築師、業主、建造商等）共同參與的密集工作會議，用來確定設施的永續設計目標和策略。這是一個關鍵的決策點——在這裡做的選擇會影響整個專案的走向。
blocks.en: Design Charrette: an intensive working meeting at the start of the project attended by all stakeholders (HVAC specialists, architects, the owner, the contractor and others) to determine the facility's sustainable design goals and strategies. This is a key decision point: the choices made here shape the direction of the whole project.

blocks.zh: OPR (Owner's Project Requirements)：永續設計中的業主需求文件，等同於製藥業的 URS (User Requirement Specification)。ISPE 指出這兩者的概念是相似的，可以整合使用。
blocks.en: OPR (Owner's Project Requirements): the owner requirements document in sustainable design, equivalent to the URS (User Requirement Specification) in the pharmaceutical industry. ISPE notes that the two concepts are similar and can be used in an integrated way.

blocks.zh: Day Lighting (自然採光)：永續設計鼓勵引入自然光和視野，但這會增加窗戶面積，進而增加 HVAC 的冷暖負荷。在製藥潔淨區，還需要特別考慮如何讓人員從潔淨區透過相鄰空間看到外面。
blocks.en: Day Lighting: sustainable design encourages bringing in natural light and views, but this increases window area and therefore the HVAC heating and cooling load. In pharmaceutical cleanrooms, special consideration is also needed on how to let personnel see outside from the clean area through adjacent spaces.

blocks.zh: Design Charette 就像蓋房子前的家庭會議——全家人坐下來討論：要幾間房？廚房朝向？要不要太陽能板？預算多少？如果等房子蓋到一半才說「我想要綠建築」，改起來又貴又慢。永續設計必須從一開始就納入，不能事後補救。
blocks.en: A Design Charrette is like a family meeting before building a house: the whole family sits down to discuss how many rooms, which way the kitchen faces, whether to have solar panels, and what the budget is. If you wait until the house is half built to say "I want a green building", changes are expensive and slow. Sustainable design must be built in from the start and cannot be remedied afterwards.

blocks.zh: 製藥業的確認與驗證 (C&Q) 天然與永續調試 (Cx) 互補：製藥業的 IQ/OQ/PQ 流程比一般商業建築的調試更嚴格、更全面。ISPE 指出，製藥調試流程已經涵蓋了永續調試的大部分要求，只需要少量補充即可。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical Commissioning and Qualification (C&Q) naturally complements sustainable Commissioning (Cx): the IQ/OQ/PQ process in the pharmaceutical industry is more rigorous and comprehensive than commissioning for ordinary commercial buildings. ISPE notes that the pharmaceutical commissioning process already covers most of the requirements of sustainable commissioning, needing only minor additions.

blocks.zh: Energy Modeling（能源建模）：現代建築法規（如 ASHRAE 90.1）要求能源效能可以通過建模或規範性方法來證明。對於追求綠建築認證的設施，建模幾乎是必要的——它能量化你的設計比基準節省多少能源。
blocks.en: Energy Modeling: modern building codes (such as ASHRAE 90.1) require that energy performance can be demonstrated either by modeling or by a prescriptive method. For facilities pursuing green building certification, modeling is almost essential, because it quantifies how much energy your design saves compared with the baseline.

blocks.zh: LEED 認證等級：Certified（40-49分）→ Silver（50-59分）→ Gold（60-79分）→ Platinum（80+分）。製藥設施因為潔淨室的高能耗限制，通常以 Silver 或 Gold 為目標。
blocks.en: LEED certification levels: Certified (40-49 points) → Silver (50-59 points) → Gold (60-79 points) → Platinum (80+ points). Because of the high energy consumption of cleanrooms, pharmaceutical facilities usually target Silver or Gold.

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 正在規劃新廠房，以下是將永續設計納入 HVAC 的實務建議：
blocks.en: If your CDMO is planning a new building, here are practical recommendations for incorporating sustainable design into HVAC:

blocks.zh: 在概念設計階段舉辦 Design Charette：確保 HVAC 團隊從一開始就參與永續目標設定
blocks.en: Hold a Design Charrette at the concept design stage: ensure the HVAC team takes part in setting sustainability goals from the start

blocks.zh: 整合 URS 和 OPR：避免兩套平行的需求文件，用一份整合文件同時滿足 GMP 和永續要求
blocks.en: Integrate the URS and OPR: avoid two parallel requirements documents, and use one integrated document to meet both GMP and sustainability requirements

blocks.zh: 早期進行能源建模：比較不同 HVAC 方案的能耗差異，為成本決策提供數據支撐
blocks.en: Carry out energy modeling early: compare the energy consumption of different HVAC options to provide data support for cost decisions

blocks.zh: 利用 C&Q 流程：在既有的 IQ/OQ/PQ 框架中加入永續調試的查核項目
blocks.en: Use the C&Q process: add sustainable commissioning checks into the existing IQ/OQ/PQ framework

blocks.zh: 你的公司在新建或翻新專案中是否舉辦過類似 Design Charette 的工作坊？HVAC 團隊是否在專案初期就參與永續目標設定？
blocks.en: Has your company held a workshop similar to a Design Charrette in a new-build or renovation project? Did the HVAC team take part in setting sustainability goals at the start of the project?

blocks.zh: 製藥業的 URS 和永續設計的 OPR 有哪些共同點和差異？如何整合這兩份文件？
blocks.en: What do the pharmaceutical URS and the sustainable design OPR have in common, and how do they differ? How can the two documents be integrated?

blocks.zh: 15.2.6-15.2.9 IAQ, Measurement, Renewable Energy & Materials 15.2.6-15.2.9 室內空氣品質、量測、再生能源與材料
blocks.en: 15.2.6-15.2.9 IAQ, Measurement, Renewable Energy & Materials

blocks.zh: IAQ Management Plan (室內空氣品質管理計畫)：施工期間的空氣品質管理計畫，確保建造過程中不會在建築內累積有毒物質或產生黴菌。這與製藥業的潔淨室施工管理有很多共通之處。
blocks.en: IAQ Management Plan: an air quality management plan for the construction period, ensuring that toxic substances do not accumulate in the building or mold form during construction. This has a lot in common with cleanroom construction management in the pharmaceutical industry.

blocks.zh: Measurement & Verification (量測與驗證)：安裝公用設施的計量設備，持續追蹤能源消耗模式。這是持續改善能源效率的基礎——你無法管理你不測量的東西。
blocks.en: Measurement & Verification: installing metering equipment on utilities to continuously track energy consumption patterns. This is the basis for continuous improvement of energy efficiency: you cannot manage what you do not measure.

blocks.zh: Geothermal Energy (地熱能)：利用地下恆溫（通常 10-15°C）作為 HVAC 的熱匯或熱源。在台灣某些地區可能有地熱資源可以利用。
blocks.en: Geothermal Energy: using the constant underground temperature (usually 10-15°C) as a heat sink or heat source for HVAC. Some areas of Taiwan may have geothermal resources that can be used.

blocks.zh: 施工期間的 IAQ 管理就像裝修新家時的防護措施——如果裝修時不遮蔽冷氣管道、不通風散味，搬進去後可能甲醛超標、冷氣裡滿是灰塵。在製藥設施的建造中，這個概念更加重要，因為任何殘留污染都可能影響未來的 GMP 生產。
blocks.en: IAQ management during construction is like protective measures when renovating a new home: if you do not cover the air conditioning ducts and do not ventilate to clear odors during renovation, then after moving in the formaldehyde level may exceed limits and the air conditioner may be full of dust. In the construction of a pharmaceutical facility this concept matters even more, because any residual contamination can affect future GMP production.

blocks.zh: 製藥設施施工管理的天然優勢：製藥業在施工期間本來就有嚴格的潔淨管控措施（管道封口、環境監測、清潔驗證等），這些措施大部分已經滿足了永續設計中 IAQ Management 的要求。
blocks.en: The natural advantage of pharmaceutical facility construction management: the pharmaceutical industry already applies strict cleanliness controls during construction (duct end capping, environmental monitoring, cleaning validation and so on), and most of these measures already satisfy the IAQ Management requirements of sustainable design.

blocks.zh: 能源計量是節能的第一步：很多老舊設施缺乏分區能源計量，只知道整棟建築的總電費，卻不知道各 AHU、冷水機、鍋爐各消耗多少。安裝智慧電表和流量計，才能找出「能源吸血鬼」並針對性改善。
blocks.en: Energy metering is the first step in energy saving: many older facilities lack zone-level energy metering. They know only the total electricity bill of the whole building, but not how much each AHU, chiller and boiler consumes. Installing smart meters and flow meters is how you find the "energy vampires" and target improvements.

blocks.zh: LEED 對 MEP 材料的限制：LEED 的回收材料學分僅適用於非機電管道材料。HVAC 設備本身的金屬材料通常已具有一定的回收含量，但不能直接獲得這方面的學分。
blocks.en: LEED restrictions on MEP materials: the LEED recycled content credit applies only to non-MEP piping materials. The metal materials of the HVAC equipment itself usually already have some recycled content, but this cannot directly earn credits.

blocks.zh: 你的設施是否安裝了分區能源計量設備？如果能追蹤每台 AHU 的能耗，你預計能找到哪些節能機會？
blocks.en: Has your facility installed zone-level energy metering equipment? If you could track the energy consumption of each AHU, what energy-saving opportunities do you expect to find?

blocks.zh: 在台灣的氣候條件下，太陽能和地熱能對 HVAC 系統有多大的補充效益？投資回收期大約是多少？
blocks.en: Under Taiwan's climate conditions, how much supplementary benefit do solar and geothermal energy offer an HVAC system? Roughly what is the payback period?

blocks.zh: 15.2.10-15.2.14 Refrigerants, Indoor Environment & Summary 15.2.10-15.2.14 冷媒、室內環境與總結
blocks.en: 15.2.10-15.2.14 Refrigerants, Indoor Environment & Summary

blocks.zh: ODP (Ozone Depletion Potential, 臭氧破壞潛勢)：衡量冷媒對臭氧層破壞程度的指標。蒙特婁議定書（1987）淘汰了 CFC，其修正案（1992）進一步淘汰 HCFC。現代冷媒如 R-134a (HFC) 的 ODP = 0，但 GWP 仍然較高。
blocks.en: ODP (Ozone Depletion Potential): an indicator of how much a refrigerant damages the ozone layer. The Montreal Protocol (1987) phased out CFCs, and its amendment (1992) further phased out HCFCs. Modern refrigerants such as R-134a (HFC) have an ODP = 0, but their GWP is still relatively high.

blocks.zh: GWP (Global Warming Potential, 全球暖化潛勢)：衡量冷媒對全球暖化貢獻的指標。京都議定書（1997）要求減少高 GWP 氣體的使用。新一代冷媒（如 R-1234yf）具有極低的 GWP。
blocks.en: GWP (Global Warming Potential): an indicator of a refrigerant's contribution to global warming. The Kyoto Protocol (1997) required a reduction in the use of high-GWP gases. New-generation refrigerants (such as R-1234yf) have a very low GWP.

blocks.zh: VOCs (Volatile Organic Compounds, 揮發性有機化合物)：建材和 HVAC 組件（膠合劑、密封劑等）可能釋放的有害氣體。在永續設計中，必須選用低 VOC 材料以保護建築使用者的健康。
blocks.en: VOCs (Volatile Organic Compounds): harmful gases that may be released by building materials and HVAC components (adhesives, sealants and so on). In sustainable design, low-VOC materials must be selected to protect the health of building occupants.

blocks.zh: Carbon Footprint (碳足跡)：冷媒管理是 HVAC 系統碳足跡的重要組成部分。一公斤 R-410A 洩漏的溫室效應等同於 2,088 公斤 CO₂。
blocks.en: Carbon Footprint: refrigerant management is an important component of an HVAC system's carbon footprint. The greenhouse effect of one kilogram of leaked R-410A is equivalent to 2,088 kilograms of CO₂.

blocks.zh: 冷媒的 ODP 和 GWP 就像食品的健康標示——ODP 是「對你身體有害的成分」（破壞臭氧層＝曬傷風險），GWP 是「對環境有害的成分」（溫室效應＝全球暖化）。理想的冷媒就像理想的食品——兩個指標都要低。
blocks.en: Refrigerant ODP and GWP are like the health labels on food: ODP is the "ingredient harmful to your body" (damaging the ozone layer = sunburn risk), and GWP is the "ingredient harmful to the environment" (greenhouse effect = global warming). An ideal refrigerant is like an ideal food: both indicators should be low.

blocks.zh: 製藥設施在 IAQ 方面天生達標：ISPE 指出，製藥設施通常引入遠超 IAQ 法規要求的外氣量，CO₂ 濃度在正常操作下不會成為問題。同樣，製藥設施的高效過濾系統（HEPA/ULPA）遠超一般建築的空氣過濾要求。這意味著製藥設施在 IAQ 相關的永續學分上有天然優勢。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical facilities naturally meet IAQ requirements: ISPE notes that pharmaceutical facilities usually bring in far more outside air than IAQ regulations require, so CO₂ concentration is not a problem under normal operation. Likewise, the high-efficiency filtration systems (HEPA/ULPA) of pharmaceutical facilities far exceed the air filtration requirements of ordinary buildings. This means pharmaceutical facilities have a natural advantage in IAQ-related sustainability credits.

blocks.zh: 冷媒管理的未來挑戰：歐盟 F-gas 法規和基加利修正案正在逐步限制高 GWP 冷媒的使用。在選擇冷水機和 DX 系統時，應考慮冷媒的長期供應風險和未來法規變化。低 GWP 冷媒（如 R-513A、R-1234ze）可能增加設備成本，但能降低長期合規風險。
blocks.en: Future challenges in refrigerant management: the EU F-gas Regulation and the Kigali Amendment are progressively restricting the use of high-GWP refrigerants. When selecting chillers and DX systems, consider the long-term supply risk of the refrigerant and future regulatory changes. Low-GWP refrigerants (such as R-513A and R-1234ze) may increase equipment cost, but they reduce long-term compliance risk.

blocks.zh: HVAC 工程師在永續設計中的角色：ISPE 在總結中強調，HVAC 工程師必須參與並理解綠建築評級系統。這不是「額外工作」，而是現代 HVAC 工程師的核心能力之一。
blocks.en: The role of the HVAC engineer in sustainable design: in its summary, ISPE stresses that HVAC engineers must participate in and understand green building rating systems. This is not "extra work" but one of the core competencies of the modern HVAC engineer.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的永續設計實務建議匯總：
blocks.en: Summary of practical recommendations on sustainable design for CDMOs:

blocks.zh: 冷媒選擇：新設備優先選用低 GWP 冷媒（R-513A、R-1234ze），避免未來被迫更換
blocks.en: Refrigerant selection: for new equipment, prefer low-GWP refrigerants (R-513A, R-1234ze) to avoid being forced to replace them in future

blocks.zh: VOC 管控：HVAC 施工中使用的膠合劑、密封劑和防火填縫材料都需符合 VOC 限值
blocks.en: VOC control: the adhesives, sealants and fire-stopping caulks used in HVAC construction must all comply with VOC limits

blocks.zh: 利用製藥設施的天然優勢：高效過濾、大外氣量、嚴格的施工管控——這些都是永續學分的加分項
blocks.en: Make use of the natural advantages of pharmaceutical facilities: high-efficiency filtration, large outside air volumes and strict construction controls are all plus points for sustainability credits

blocks.zh: 非 GMP 區域的人員舒適度：辦公區、倉庫區可以提供個人溫控選項，既增加員工滿意度又能獲得永續學分
blocks.en: Personnel comfort in non-GMP areas: office and warehouse areas can offer individual temperature control options, which both increases employee satisfaction and earns sustainability credits

blocks.zh: 你的設施目前使用什麼冷媒？它的 ODP 和 GWP 值是多少？是否需要規劃未來的冷媒轉換？
blocks.en: What refrigerant does your facility currently use? What are its ODP and GWP values? Do you need to plan a future refrigerant changeover?

blocks.zh: 製藥設施在哪些永續設計領域有天然優勢？哪些領域面臨最大挑戰？
blocks.en: In which areas of sustainable design do pharmaceutical facilities have a natural advantage, and which areas face the greatest challenges?

blocks.zh: ISPE 說「HVAC 工程師不能單獨交付建築評級」——在你的組織中，永續設計的責任是如何分配的？
blocks.en: ISPE says "the HVAC engineer cannot deliver the building rating alone". In your organization, how is responsibility for sustainable design allocated?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Life Cycle Cost > Capital Cost：HVAC 系統的營運成本（能源、耗材、維護）通常遠超過初始資本支出。應在專案早期建立成本模型，用 NPV 或 IRR 等財務工具評估設計方案。
blocks.en: Life Cycle Cost > Capital Cost: the operating cost of an HVAC system (energy, consumables, maintenance) usually far exceeds the initial capital expenditure. A cost model should be built early in the project, and design options evaluated with financial tools such as NPV or IRR.

blocks.zh: 故障影響驅動冗餘投資：HVAC 故障可能導致整批產品報廢或長期試驗數據失效。冗餘設計的投資決策應基於風險評估的量化結果（故障機率 × 損失金額）。
blocks.en: Failure impact drives redundancy investment: an HVAC failure can lead to the loss of an entire batch or the invalidation of long-term study data. Redundancy investment decisions should be based on quantified risk assessment results (probability of failure × loss amount).

blocks.zh: 不要過度規格：更窄的溫濕度容差不等於更好的系統。過度規格只會增加成本和維護複雜度，而不會為產品品質帶來額外價值。
blocks.en: Do not over-specify: a narrower temperature and humidity tolerance does not mean a better system. Over-specification only adds cost and maintenance complexity, and brings no extra value to product quality.

blocks.zh: 能源回收技術各有適用場景：Run Around Coil 最適合製藥設施（供排氣可分離、僅回收顯熱、無交叉污染風險），Enthalpy Wheel 因交叉污染顧慮在製藥中很少使用。
blocks.en: Each energy recovery technology has its own applications: the Run Around Coil is best suited to pharmaceutical facilities (supply and exhaust can be separated, sensible heat only, no cross-contamination risk), while the Enthalpy Wheel is rarely used in pharmaceutical facilities because of cross-contamination concerns.

blocks.zh: 夜間降載是低成本高回報的節能措施：從 20+ AC/hr 降至 6 AC/hr，風機功率可降至正常的 2.7%。但必須維持壓差關係和臨界條件。
blocks.en: Night setback is a low-cost, high-return energy-saving measure: going from 20+ AC/hr down to 6 AC/hr can reduce fan power to 2.7% of normal. But pressure differential relationships and critical conditions must be maintained.

blocks.zh: 永續設計正從選擇題變成必答題：LEED 等綠建築評級系統正被納入建築法規。CDMO 擁有 LEED 認證可能成為未來的市場差異化因素。
blocks.en: Sustainable design is moving from optional to compulsory: green building rating systems such as LEED are being incorporated into building codes. For a CDMO, holding LEED certification may become a market differentiator in future.

blocks.zh: 製藥設施在多項永續指標上有天然優勢：高效過濾、大外氣量、嚴格的施工管控已經滿足許多永續設計要求，善加利用可以降低取得綠建築認證的額外成本。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical facilities have a natural advantage on many sustainability indicators: high-efficiency filtration, large outside air volumes and strict construction controls already meet many sustainable design requirements, and making good use of them can reduce the extra cost of obtaining green building certification.

blocks.zh: HVAC 工程師是永續設計的關鍵角色：必須從 Design Charette 階段就參與，理解評級系統，並將永續考量整合進 GMP 設計流程中。
blocks.en: The HVAC engineer is a key player in sustainable design: they must be involved from the Design Charrette stage, understand the rating systems, and integrate sustainability considerations into the GMP design process.
